metrics.visualTitle: Attrition breakdown by Job Satisfaction | OverTime

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Dim Labels'[Label],
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Fact'[OverTime], "IsGrandTotalColumnTotal"),
			"Total_Attrition", 'Measures - All'[Total Attrition]
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreOnlyOutputTotals = 
		SELECTCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal] = FALSE)),
			"'Dim Labels'[Label]", 'Dim Labels'[Label],
			"'Fact'[OverTime]", 'Fact'[OverTime],
			"Total_Attrition", [Total_Attrition]
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreTableByDM0 = 
		SELECTCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal] = TRUE)),
			"'Dim Labels'[Label]", 'Dim Labels'[Label],
			"SortBy_DM0_0", [Total_Attrition]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWithSortColumns = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Dim Labels'[Label]),
			__DS0CoreTableByDM0
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(201, __DS0PrimaryWithSortColumns, [SortBy_DM0_0], 0, 'Dim Labels'[Label], 1)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0CoreOnlyOutputTotals, 'Fact'[OverTime])

	VAR __DS0Secondary = 
		TOPN(62, __DS0SecondaryBase, 'Fact'[OverTime], 1)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0CoreOnlyOutputTotals,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				'Fact'[OverTime],
				ASC
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary

ORDER BY
	'Fact'[OverTime]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	[SortBy_DM0_0] DESC, 'Dim Labels'[Label], [ColumnIndex]

metrics.visualTitle: Avg. Monthly Income By Job Role

DEFINE

	VAR __DS0CoreOnlyOutputTotals = 
		SELECTCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal] = FALSE)),
			"'Dim JobRole'[JobRole]", 'Dim JobRole'[JobRole],
			"'Fact'[Attrition]", 'Fact'[Attrition],
			"Avg__Monthly_Income", [Avg__Monthly_Income]
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreTableByDM1 = 
		SELECTCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal] = TRUE)),

			"SortBy_DM1_0", [Avg__Monthly_Income]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWithSortColumns = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Dim JobRole'[JobRole]),
			__DS0CoreTableByDM1
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed =

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase =

ORDER BY

	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	[SortBy_DM1_0] DESC, 'Dim JobRole'[JobRole], [ColumnIndex]

metrics.visualTitle: Monthly Income vs. Total Working Years

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __SQDS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZE('Fact', 'Fact'[Attrition], 'Fact'[MonthlyIncome], 'Fact'[TotalWorkingYears])

	VAR __SQDS0BodyLimited = 
		TOPN(
			2000,
			__SQDS0Core,
			'Fact'[Attrition],
			1,
			'Fact'[MonthlyIncome],
			1,
			'Fact'[TotalWorkingYears],
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		CALCULATETABLE(
			SUMMARIZE('Fact', 'Fact'[Attrition], 'Fact'[MonthlyIncome], 'Fact'[TotalWorkingYears]),
			KEEPFILTERS(__SQDS0BodyLimited)
		)

	VAR __DS0IntersectionCount = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0Core))

	VAR __DS0BodyOverlappingPointsSample = 
		SAMPLECARTESIANPOINTSBYCOVER(3500, __DS0Core, 'Fact'[MonthlyIncome], 'Fact'[TotalWorkingYears])

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"DS0IntersectionCount", __DS0IntersectionCount
)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyOverlappingPointsSample

ORDER BY
	'Fact'[Attrition], 'Fact'[MonthlyIncome], 'Fact'[TotalWorkingYears]

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"Stagnant_Employees", 'Measures - All'[Stagnant Employees]
)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"Avg__Job_Satisfaction", 'Measures - All'[Avg. Job Satisfaction]
)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"Early_Attrition", 'Measures - All'[Early Attrition]
)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"High_Performers_Attrition_Rate", 'Measures - All'[High Performers Attrition Rate]
	)

metrics.visualTitle: Attrition Rate By Total Years in Current Role

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Fact'[YearsInCurrentRole (bins)],
			"Attrition_Rate", 'Measures - All'[Attrition Rate]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, 'Fact'[YearsInCurrentRole (bins)], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'Fact'[YearsInCurrentRole (bins)]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Yes"}, 'Fact'[Attrition])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SELECTCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(
				FILTER(
					KEEPFILTERS(
						SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
							'Fact'[EmployeeNumber],
							'Dim Gender'[Gender],
							'Fact'[Age],
							'Dim MaritalStatus'[MaritalStatus],
							'Dim Department'[Department],
							'Dim JobRole'[JobRole],
							'Fact'[MonthlyIncome],
							'Fact'[NumCompaniesWorked],
							'Fact'[YearsAtCompany],
							'Fact'[TotalWorkingYears],
							'Fact'[YearsInCurrentRole],
							'Fact'[EnvironmentSatisfaction],
							'Dim Labels'[Label],
							'Dim Labels - Performance'[Label],
							'Fact'[RelationshipSatisfaction],
							'Fact'[WorkLifeBalance],
							__DS0FilterTable,
							"SumYearsInCurrentRole", IGNORE(CALCULATE(SUM('Fact'[YearsInCurrentRole]))),
							"MinJobRole", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('Dim JobRole'[JobRole]))),
							"CountLabel", IGNORE(CALCULATE(COUNTA('Dim Labels'[Label]))),
							"MinLabel", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('Dim Labels'[Label]))),
							"Dim_Labels___PerformanceCountLabel", IGNORE(CALCULATE(COUNTA('Dim Labels - Performance'[Label]))),
							"Dim_Labels___PerformanceMinLabel", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('Dim Labels - Performance'[Label]))),
							"CountRowsFact", COUNTROWS('Fact')
						)
					),
					OR(
						OR(
							OR(
								OR(
									OR(
										OR(
											OR(
												OR(
													OR(
														OR(
															OR(
																OR(
																	OR(
																		OR(
																			OR(
																				NOT(ISBLANK('Fact'[EmployeeNumber])),
																				NOT(ISBLANK('Dim Gender'[Gender]))
																			),
																			NOT(ISBLANK('Fact'[Age]))
																		),
																		NOT(ISBLANK('Dim MaritalStatus'[MaritalStatus]))
																	),
																	NOT(ISBLANK('Dim Department'[Department]))
																),
																NOT(ISBLANK('Dim JobRole'[JobRole]))
															),
															NOT(ISBLANK('Fact'[MonthlyIncome]))
														),
														NOT(ISBLANK('Fact'[NumCompaniesWorked]))
													),
													NOT(ISBLANK('Fact'[YearsAtCompany]))
												),
												NOT(ISBLANK('Fact'[TotalWorkingYears]))
											),
											NOT(ISBLANK('Fact'[YearsInCurrentRole]))
										),
										NOT(ISBLANK('Fact'[EnvironmentSatisfaction]))
									),
									NOT(ISBLANK('Dim Labels'[Label]))
								),
								NOT(ISBLANK('Dim Labels - Performance'[Label]))
							),
							NOT(ISBLANK('Fact'[RelationshipSatisfaction]))
						),
						NOT(ISBLANK('Fact'[WorkLifeBalance]))
					)
				)
			),
			"'Fact'[EmployeeNumber]", 'Fact'[EmployeeNumber],
			"'Dim Gender'[Gender]", 'Dim Gender'[Gender],
			"'Fact'[Age]", 'Fact'[Age],
			"'Dim MaritalStatus'[MaritalStatus]", 'Dim MaritalStatus'[MaritalStatus],
			"'Dim Department'[Department]", 'Dim Department'[Department],
			"'Dim JobRole'[JobRole]", 'Dim JobRole'[JobRole],
			"'Fact'[MonthlyIncome]", 'Fact'[MonthlyIncome],
			"'Fact'[NumCompaniesWorked]", 'Fact'[NumCompaniesWorked],
			"'Fact'[YearsAtCompany]", 'Fact'[YearsAtCompany],
			"'Fact'[TotalWorkingYears]", 'Fact'[TotalWorkingYears],
			"'Fact'[YearsInCurrentRole]", 'Fact'[YearsInCurrentRole],
			"'Fact'[EnvironmentSatisfaction]", 'Fact'[EnvironmentSatisfaction],
			"'Dim Labels'[Label]", 'Dim Labels'[Label],
			"'Dim Labels - Performance'[Label]", 'Dim Labels - Performance'[Label],
			"'Fact'[RelationshipSatisfaction]", 'Fact'[RelationshipSatisfaction],
			"'Fact'[WorkLifeBalance]", 'Fact'[WorkLifeBalance],
			"SumYearsInCurrentRole", [SumYearsInCurrentRole],
			"MinJobRole", [MinJobRole],
			"CountLabel", [CountLabel],
			"MinLabel", [MinLabel],
			"Dim_Labels___PerformanceCountLabel", [Dim_Labels___PerformanceCountLabel],
			"Dim_Labels___PerformanceMinLabel", [Dim_Labels___PerformanceMinLabel]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			501,
			__DS0Core,
			'Fact'[EmployeeNumber],
			1,
			'Dim Gender'[Gender],
			1,
			'Fact'[Age],
			1,
			'Dim MaritalStatus'[MaritalStatus],
			1,
			'Dim Department'[Department],
			1,
			'Dim JobRole'[JobRole],
			1,
			'Fact'[MonthlyIncome],
			1,
			'Fact'[NumCompaniesWorked],
			1,
			'Fact'[YearsAtCompany],
			1,
			'Fact'[TotalWorkingYears],
			1,
			'Fact'[YearsInCurrentRole],
			1,
			'Fact'[EnvironmentSatisfaction],
			1,
			'Dim Labels'[Label],
			1,
			'Dim Labels - Performance'[Label],
			1,
			'Fact'[RelationshipSatisfaction],
			1,
			'Fact'[WorkLifeBalance],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0Core,
		"MinNumCompaniesWorked", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), 'Fact'[NumCompaniesWorked]),
		"MaxNumCompaniesWorked", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), 'Fact'[NumCompaniesWorked]),
		"MinYearsAtCompany", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), 'Fact'[YearsAtCompany]),
		"MaxYearsAtCompany", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), 'Fact'[YearsAtCompany]),
		"MinTotalWorkingYears", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), 'Fact'[TotalWorkingYears]),
		"MaxTotalWorkingYears", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), 'Fact'[TotalWorkingYears]),
		"MinSumYearsInCurrentRole", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [SumYearsInCurrentRole]),
		"MaxSumYearsInCurrentRole", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [SumYearsInCurrentRole]),
		"MinCountLabel", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [CountLabel]),
		"MaxCountLabel", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [CountLabel]),
		"MinDim_Labels___PerformanceCountLabel", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Dim_Labels___PerformanceCountLabel]),
		"MaxDim_Labels___PerformanceCountLabel", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Dim_Labels___PerformanceCountLabel])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'Fact'[EmployeeNumber],
	'Dim Gender'[Gender],
	'Fact'[Age],
	'Dim MaritalStatus'[MaritalStatus],
	'Dim Department'[Department],
	'Dim JobRole'[JobRole],
	'Fact'[MonthlyIncome],
	'Fact'[NumCompaniesWorked],
	'Fact'[YearsAtCompany],
	'Fact'[TotalWorkingYears],
	'Fact'[YearsInCurrentRole],
	'Fact'[EnvironmentSatisfaction],
	'Dim Labels'[Label],
	'Dim Labels - Performance'[Label],
	'Fact'[RelationshipSatisfaction],
	'Fact'[WorkLifeBalance]
